test_receipts.result: boots to the desktop; Wi-Fi works; touchpad works; brightness keys change the indicator but not the panel; battery and power management not checked; kernel log equals the log of the earlier boot with vendor firmware

limitations: The release image (build .2) itself was not booted on the laptop; the previous build (.1) was. They differ only by the removal of Firefox and Arch branding.
Screen brightness keys change the on-screen indicator but not the panel brightness.
Battery level, charging state and power management are not working or not verified; audio, camera, USB-C power delivery, suspend and GPU acceleration are not claimed.
Touchpad works in basic mouse mode only (polling driver): no tap-to-click or gestures.
Boot loader and kernel images are unsigned; Secure Boot must be off. The downloads are signed (SHA256SUMS.asc).
No vendor firmware is included. Default live accounts are those of the development image (user live, password live).
Arch Linux ARM publishes no explicit redistribution statement; the maintainer acceptance of the three-year written source offer is recorded at release approval.
